input_conditions: Cookie has SameSite attribute set to 'Lax'
Cookie name does not begin with '__Secure-' or '__Host-'
reproduction_steps: 1. Set a cookie with SameSite='Lax' attribute
2. Call HttpResponseBase.delete_cookie() to expire the cookie
3. Observe the Set-Cookie header in the response
4. Note that SameSite attribute is missing and Secure is not set unless cookie name starts with '__Secure-' or '__Host-'
expected: delete_cookie should preserve the cookie's SameSite attribute and set the Secure flag appropriately
actual: delete_cookie does not set the SameSite attribute and only sets Secure if the cookie name begins with '__Secure-' or '__Host-'
